title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-10
lineage: (set 1: SBD> MR), (set 2: AUD> MR> R) > D> CD> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear matrix recording captures a high‑energy Black Queen show with smoking jams on Cryptical, The Other One and guest Stephen Stills highlights.
ai_review.review: The Dead deliver one of their most exhilarating performances – tight, soaring jams on Cryptical Envelopment, The Other One, Cosmic Charlie and soulful renditions of Schoolgirl and Morning Dew featuring Stephen Stills.  The matrix source is radiantly clear, though the final “Cosmic Charlie” segment drops out.  Overall the show feels vibrant, inventive and well‑recorded.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong, consistent praise for musical performance (mostly 5‑star reviews) combined with a clear but slightly flawed recording yields an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as crystal‑clear, radiantly clear and pure; however one reviewer notes that the ending of “Cosmic Charlie” cuts out.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows seamlessly with each song finding the band at the top of their game, delivering tight transitions and expansive jams.
